context.why: US1-US3 built the record views, fields and RecordMultipleFilter in fairdm/contrib/autocomplete (views, fields, filters, throttling, urls; tests in tests/test_contrib/test_autocomplete/). Read them and follow their patterns; extend, do not restructure. US5 adds PersonAutocompleteView and OrganizationAutocompleteView (with LimitedAutocompleteMixin, the throttles and allow-lists), their single and multiple fields, rows drawn from the approved template autocomplete/contributor_option.html (keep its markup: avatar, name, affiliation as plain text, ORCID on its own line beneath for a person, place and no ROR for an organization, 'Unclaimed' badge). Grouping: people the requester has worked with (Contributor.get_collaborators) first; organizations the requester is a member of (verified, current affiliation; a pending request does not count) first. People come from Person.objects.real(). Never search or show email; e=/ordering= naming email change nothing. Move: AffiliationForm.organization, organization profile parent, PersonCreateForm.affiliations, person merge target (and add {{ form.media }} to merge_person.html), ownership-transfer action form new_owner, ProjectForm.owner, UpdateContributionForm.roles to mvp_forms.widgets.TomSelectMultiple(counted=True), and the project list's owner and contributor filters to RecordMultipleFilter with the organization and person multiple fields. Delete ContributorSelect2Widget, PersonSelect2Widget, OrganizationSelect2Widget and QuickAddContributionForm. Known state of the base: one test, test_form_handles_cross_dataset_sample_reference, fails pending the maintainer; leave it and the measurement sample field alone.
prior_decisions: D1: a field that places a record inside another needs edit; linking needs view; a public list filter offers public records only, to everyone.
D3: visibility rules are taken as they stand (project by visibility; dataset by get_visible on all_objects; sample/measurement by public+published dataset).
D4: a stored link to a record the editor cannot see is kept and shown as a private record without its name.
D12: limits on the pattern of fairdm/api/throttling.py, refused before any query.

D13: design review. django-tomselect rebuilds the validation view as view_class() (lazy_utils.py:107) and with the current page's q/f/e. So: one view subclass per scope (scope is a class attribute), and FairDM fields validate through the view's offered(user, owner=, type=, depends_on=) and never call django-tomselect's clean(). Use django-tomselect's allowed_filter_fields and allowed_ordering_fields, not a custom allow-list.
Upstream gaps are tracked in this repository's issue #554. Put '#554' in the comments of the two django_tomselect templates.
FR-021 (the 'searching is paused' message) is with the maintainer. Do NOT build it and do NOT write a skipped test for it.
